description: Tools Page – TealHQ Visual & Functional Parity. Create a new /[locale]/tools page that visually and functionally replicates TealHQ's Tools page with 7 career tools.

userStories.title: Create tools page route and basic structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the page route and basic layout structure so other components can be added.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /src/app/[locale]/(marketing)/tools/page.tsx
Page renders without errors at /en/tools
Basic metadata (title, description) set for SEO
Page uses existing layout wrapper
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
userStories.notes: Server component with SEO metadata, hero section, placeholder grid. Build and lint pass.

userStories.title: Create tool card component
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable ToolCard component to display each tool consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Component accepts: icon (LucideIcon), title, description, href props
Card layout: icon at top, title below, description below title, entire card is clickable link
Proper spacing and alignment (p-6 padding, gap-4 between elements)
Component located at /src/components/marketing/tool-card.tsx
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
userStories.notes: Server component with LucideIcon typing, teal gradient icon container, Link wrapper.

userStories.title: Implement tool card hover and focus states
userStories.description: As a user, I want visual feedback when interacting with tool cards.
acceptanceCriteria: Hover state: subtle shadow elevation (shadow-md) and slight scale (scale-[1.02])
Focus state: visible focus ring (ring-2 ring-primary) for accessibility
Smooth transition (transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out)
Cursor changes to pointer on hover
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added hover shadow/scale, focus-visible ring with offset, 200ms transitions.

userStories.title: Create tools grid layout with hero section
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a clear header and all tools in an organized grid.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section with centered title 'Career Tools' and subtitle explaining page purpose
Grid layout: 3 columns on desktop (lg:grid-cols-3), 2 on tablet (md:grid-cols-2), 1 on mobile
Consistent gap spacing (gap-6) between cards
Grid centered within max-w-6xl container with px-4 padding
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Hero with centered title/subtitle, responsive grid layout, ToolCard integration with initial tools.

userStories.title: Add all 7 tool cards with icons and descriptions
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see all career tools with appropriate icons and descriptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Resume Checker: FileCheck icon, links to /[locale]/tools/resume-checker
Resume Job Description Match: Target icon, links to /[locale]/tools/resume-job-match
Cover Letter Generator: PenLine icon, links to /[locale]/tools/cover-letter-generator
Resume Reviewer: MessageSquareText icon, links to /[locale]/tools/resume-reviewer
Resume Grammar Checker: SpellCheck icon, links to /[locale]/tools/resume-grammar-checker
CV Checker: FileSearch icon, links to /[locale]/tools/cv-checker
Cover Letter Checker: FileCheck2 icon, links to /[locale]/tools/cover-letter-checker
Each tool has original description text (not copied from TealHQ)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: All 7 tools with correct icons and original descriptions. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Create placeholder tool detail page template
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a placeholder page for individual tools so links work.
acceptanceCriteria: Create dynamic route /src/app/[locale]/(marketing)/tools/[tool]/page.tsx
Displays tool name from URL parameter (formatted with proper capitalization)
Shows 'Coming Soon' message with consistent styling
Includes back link to main tools page
All 7 tool routes render without errors
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Dynamic route with formatToolName(), Coming Soon styling, back links. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Add i18n translations for tools page (English)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need English translations for the tools page content.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tools namespace to /src/locales/en/ (tools.json or in common.json)
Include translations for: page title, page subtitle, all 7 tool titles, all 7 tool descriptions, coming soon text
Update tools page to use translation keys instead of hardcoded strings
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
userStories.notes: Created tools.json with all translations. Updated i18n.ts and use-translation.ts. Both pages use translation keys.

userStories.title: Add i18n translations for French, German, Italian
userStories.description: As a multilingual user, I want the tools page content in my language.
acceptanceCriteria: Add translations to /src/locales/fr/ for all tools page content
Add translations to /src/locales/de/ for all tools page content
Add translations to /src/locales/it/ for all tools page content
Page renders correctly at /fr/tools, /de/tools, /it/tools
No layout breaks due to longer text in other languages
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created fr/de/it tools.json files with natural translations. Updated i18n files. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Visual polish and responsive verification
userStories.description: As a user, I want the tools page to look polished and work on all screen sizes.
acceptanceCriteria: Spacing is consistent across all elements (hero, grid, cards)
Typography uses project design system (text-3xl for title, text-lg for subtitle, text-xl for card titles)
Cards have consistent border radius (rounded-lg) and subtle border or shadow
Page looks good on mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1280px)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill at multiple viewport sizes
userStories.notes: Card rounded-lg, title text-xl. Responsive padding on all sections. Typecheck passes.
